sources.role: configuration reference, mapper EVENT/BIND implementation and state implementation
per-platform config paths, mapper and save-state behavior
Flatpak app id and sandbox config path

paths.path: dosbox-x.conf in the current/program directory first; fallback ~/.config/dosbox-x/dosbox-x-<version>.conf. -conf and -defaultdir select explicit locations.
[sdl] mapperfile=mapper-dosbox-x.map (default, beside the config/default path); the mapper editor binds DOSBox-X EVENT names to SDL keyboard/joystick axis/button/hat BINDs with optional Mod1/2/3.
paths.naming: Plain mapper event/binding file selected by mapperfile; use -startmapper/-erasemapper and preserve the generated map.

paths.path: Guest game saves are ordinary files in mounted DOS directories/disk images; DOSBox-X does not impose a per-game save extension.
paths.naming: Game-defined files inside MOUNTed directories or disk images.
evidence: docs:DOSBox-X wiki storage/mount and autoexec documentation

paths.path: Save path selected by -savedir or the DOSBox-X default path; [dosbox] saveslot selects slots 1-100 and savefile can override the slot file; autosave supports a configured interval.
paths.naming: Slot-based state files (implementation-generated names) or the exact user-provided [dosbox] savefile; 100 slots total. No BIOS/game compatibility should be inferred across DOSBox-X versions.

paths.path: No external PC BIOS ROM is required for ordinary DOSBox-X PC emulation; machine/BIOS behavior is implemented by the emulator. Optional machine-specific ROM/font/device files are configuration-dependent.
paths.naming: No universal external BIOS filename or canonical checksum in DOSBox-X's official config reference.

paths.path: No external decryption/key file is documented.
~/.var/app/com.dosbox_x.DOSBox-X/config/dosbox-x/dosbox-x-<version>.conf (the Flatpak documentation explicitly identifies this config root).
mapper-dosbox-x.map selected by [sdl] mapperfile beside the Flatpak config; mapper EVENT/BIND grammar is identical to native DOSBox-X.
paths.naming: Generated plain mapper file; -startmapper edits it.

paths.path: Inside mounted game directories/disk images reachable through the Flatpak filesystem permissions.
Flatpak writable default path or explicit -savedir; slots 1-100, with [dosbox] savefile override.
paths.naming: DOSBox-X slot state files or explicit savefile name.

paths.path: No external PC BIOS required by DOSBox-X; optional machine-specific resources follow the config.
No external key file documented.
dosbox-x.conf/dosbox.conf in current or program directory first; fallback C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\DOSBox-X\dosbox-x-<version>.conf; -conf/-defaultdir override.
[sdl] mapperfile=mapper-dosbox-x.map; mapper editor stores EVENT/BIND keyboard, joystick axis/button/hat and Mod1/2/3 mappings.
Inside MOUNTed directories/disk images.
paths.naming: Game-defined files; no DOSBox-X save extension.

paths.path: -savedir selects the state directory; [dosbox] saveslot 1-100 or explicit savefile controls state storage, autosave may be enabled.
paths.naming: Slot-generated state files or explicit savefile.
evidence: docs:DOSBox-X wiki save/load state and command line
